name: Zenith Gift Card Studio Lite
author: gmscreativo

sections.description:
Zenith Gift Card Studio Lite creates a ready-to-sell virtual gift card product and a balance page from a single Settings screen. Customers choose one of your fixed amounts, enter a recipient email, and add a message. After the order is paid, the recipient and buyer receive the designed card by email with a PDF attachment. Recipients add their code to their wallet and spend their balance over multiple WooCommerce orders.

  • Fixed gift card denominations in the shop currency
  • Three configurable live-preview designs: Classic, Birthday and Anniversary, including color and optional background image
  • Recipient and sender emails with a designed PDF attachment after payment confirmation (PHP GD with FreeType required)
  • Single card per cart, with a step-by-step purchase form, selectable design previews and live character limits
  • Dedicated gift-card purchase page with a wide live card preview, one purchase panel and responsive layout
  • Fully functional free edition with no license key, trial period or limit on the number of gift cards issued
  • Personal message, names, branded email color and logo
  • Account dashboard balance, a private My Gift Cards section with masked codes, view and copy, plus a separate history of cards sent to others
  • One-time account redemption with an explicit confirmation; statuses distinguish sent, redeemed, partially used and fully used
  • Customer wallet and balance page with [zenith_gcs_wallet]
  • Balance at the end of the main WordPress menu or beside supported mini carts without duplicate header badges; both automatic positions can be turned off in Settings; [zenith_gcs_balance] for custom headers
  • Optional storefront styling, enabled by default; turn it off to inherit the active theme’s colors and typography
  • Account required when buying a gift card; customers can log in or register during checkout
  • Full or partial application of one gift card in the cart, carried into checkout
  • Ledger of issuance, spending, reservation and returns
  • Manager tools for card lookup, email retry and disabling a card
  • Partial refund balance return from card details, with manager confirmation

Gift card purchases are not eligible for coupon discounts and cannot be paid for with another gift card. Cash on delivery and cheque are disabled for gift card purchases. Gift cards use the store’s configured currency and decimal precision; changing either setting after issuance makes older cards unavailable until settings are restored. One card can be applied to an order, even when several cards are saved to the customer’s account. Buying a gift card requires an account; customers can sign in or register at checkout. Redeeming or spending a gift card also requires a logged-in account. Codes redeemed in this version are bound to the first account. Older cards saved to wallets before this version retain their previous wallet links until explicitly redeemed under the new flow.

No external plugin service or analytics connection is required. PDF creation requires PHP GD with FreeType; missing support marks delivery as failed for the manager to review. Emails use the site’s WordPress mail configuration. Test delivery in a staging store before relying on it for sales.

Customer accounts

While Lite is active (with or without Pro), checkout containing a gift card requires a customer account. Customers add gift cards to the cart normally; account prompts appear only at checkout through WooCommerce login and registration. WooCommerce can create and authenticate a new customer during checkout. Carts without gift cards follow the merchant’s existing guest checkout and checkout registration settings. The requirement is evaluated for each cart and enforced for gift-card orders on the server without overwriting stored options. My Account registration is enabled so recipients can create an account before redeeming a code. Setup creates a standard My Account page only if none is configured and published.
Redemption links carry only a validated local return URL, never the gift card code. The user returns to redemption after WooCommerce login or registration.

Privacy

Gift card records contain the recipient email and name, sender name, personal message, order reference, redemption account, balance and transaction history. These records stay in the store’s WordPress database. The store sends transactional gift card emails through its configured WordPress mail service. Store owners should include this processing in their privacy policy and determine retention appropriate to their accounting obligations. This plugin adds no analytics or tracking and requires no external service. Included Poppins fonts are bundled locally under the SIL Open Font License in assets/fonts/OFL.txt. GMS Creativo logos, banner and illustrations are distributed under the plugin’s GPL-compatible license.

Development

PHP, JavaScript, CSS and SVG sources are included in readable form. No build process is required. Direct SQL is limited to this plugin’s financial tables; identifiers and values are prepared. Targeted PHPCS annotations explain why live balances, ledger transactions and idempotency checks must not use stale object-cache values. Read-only navigation and safe local return URLs are annotated separately; all state-changing requests retain nonce and capability checks.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin ZIP in Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and activate it.
  3. Open GMS Plugins > Zenith Gift Card Studio > Settings. Enter your fixed amounts and save. A Gift Card product and Gift card balance page are created.
  4. Add the gift card product to your shop menu. If your theme has a custom mini cart not detected automatically, place [zenith_gcs_balance] next to it.
  5. Make a test purchase and confirm your payment gateway and email delivery.
sections.faq:
Does Lite require a license or expire?

No. Lite is a complete free plugin, not a trial. All included functionality remains available without a key or subscription. There is no payment-based limit on issuance or redemption. Merchant-configured gift card validity is separate from the plugin itself.

Where are Pro features implemented?

Pro is an optional separate addon distributed outside WordPress.org. Its feature code, license management and updater are not part of Lite. Lite exposes gift-card integration hooks; the promotional link opens the Pro product page only when you click it. Lite does not contact a license server or install an addon.

When are codes sent?

After a paid order reaches processing or completed status. An unpaid bank transfer or pending order never creates an active card.

What happens when payment fails?

The reserved card balance is returned. Pending and failed abandoned reservations are checked hourly after 24 hours. Review late payments manually.

How are refunds handled?

A fully refunded order returns its gift card payment. For a partial refund, the store manager can return an appropriate amount from the card details screen after reviewing the payment split. Refunding a gift card purchase disables affected cards; review any already redeemed value manually.

Does it work with every theme and gateway?

The automatic balance badge supports common cart icon selectors and WooCommerce mini cart markup; use [zenith_gcs_balance] in a custom header. Mixed gift card plus gateway payments should be tested with your particular gateway. The plugin declares WooCommerce cart/checkout block and HPOS compatibility, but your theme and gateway still determine checkout behavior.

short_description: Sell digital gift cards in WooCommerce with recipient emails, a customer wallet, partial spending, and a live balance near the cart.
